name: engineer-lane
description: Lane worker: same rigorous test-first implementer as `engineer`, under a different name so an orchestrating engineer can spawn it (an agent cannot spawn itself). Dispatch one per parallel lane with a task file path and a file-ownership list.

action.command: echo '--- Steering Context ---' && (cat AGENTS.md 2>/dev/null || echo 'No AGENTS.md') && echo '---' && (ls .kiro/steering/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'No steering docs') && echo '---' && (git status --short 2>/dev/null || echo 'Not a git repo')

welcomeMessage: Engineer lane worker. Give me a task file (docs/<feature>/tasks/<task-name>.md) plus the files I own and I'll implement it test-first.
